title: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A broken planeswalker who devours a dragon's heart in a Jeskai ritual to regain his draconic form and takes command of wild dragons.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: A zealous Jeskai monk and loyalist who guides Sarkhan through a corrupted ritual of eating a dragon's heart.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Waymaster of the Jeskai, detained by Abzan scouts and brought to Khan Felothar's court.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: An archangel and planeswalker who is impatient with the Abzan delay and shows raw emotion on seeing Ajani.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who hunts with the Abzan, witnesses Sarkhan's return as a giant dragon, and meets Elspeth and Narset again.

entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: The soldierly Abzan khan, who receives Narset and Elspeth and presides over the Council of Houses.

entities.name: Nur
entities.description: The Abzan djinni whose words to Ajani about death deferred echo in his mind.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A woman who died saving Ajani.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon under whose thumb Sarkhan once lived.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dragonlord who told the Abzan to forswear ancestral worship or be eradicated.

entities.name: Young wild dragon
entities.description: A young, playful dragon newly born from the storms, killed by Sarkhan for its heart.

entities.name: Council of Houses
entities.description: The Abzan council of house heads seated beside the khan.

entities.name: House Emesh
entities.description: An Abzan house whose elderly representative holds a grudge against Jeskai trespass.

entities.name: House Mevak
entities.description: An Abzan house led by an ainok who seeks trade for red minerals found in Jeskai lands.

entities.name: House Zanhar
entities.description: An Abzan house with records represented by a djinni woman.

entities.name: House Gudal
entities.description: An Abzan house represented by a young girl while its true head is ill.

entities.name: House Fenzala
entities.description: An Abzan house named in a trade proposal.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The clan that detains Narset and Elspeth and hunts gazelle with Ajani; its riders and dragons are attacked by Sarkhan's flight.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan led by the waymaster, at odds with the Abzan over beliefs about the dead.

entities.name: Arashin
entities.description: The Abzan homeland where Narset and Elspeth are held.

entities.name: Stormplains
entities.description: Border steppe lands where dragonstorms are fiercest.

entities.name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: The place where a voice told Narset and Elspeth to seek a temple in the dragonstorms.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: The storms that spawn dragons on Tarkir and now affect other planes.

events.summary: Sarkhan, desperate to regain his draconic form, hunts a young dragon for its heart under Taigam's direction.
events.quote: This is how you fly with a dragon's wings once more,

events.summary: Sarkhan spears the dragon and Taigam binds it with blue fire to pin it down.
events.quote: The blade sank through the dragon's cheek and then deeper

events.summary: Sarkhan cuts out the dragon's heart, chants with Taigam, senses the spell's corruption, and bites into the heart.
events.quote: he bit down into the organ.

events.summary: Abzan outriders arrest Narset and Elspeth near the stormplains and take them to Arashin for questioning.
events.quote: Incarceration by the Abzan was not part of Narset's plan.

events.summary: Narset persuades an impatient Elspeth to wait one more hour, explaining the Jeskai-Abzan tension over the dead.
events.quote: Dromoka all but informed the Abzan that their clan would be eradicated if they didn't forswear their ancestral worship.

events.summary: Ajani prepares to lead Abzan riders in a gazelle hunt, unsettled by the herd and Nur's words.
events.quote: Much to his chagrin, Nur had gotten into his head with that last conversation.

events.summary: A wave of magic panics the herd and the Abzan dragons throw their riders as a huge red dragon rises with a flight of smaller ones.
events.quote: a dragon of improbable size: red-scaled, triumphant, roaring as dozens of its smaller brethren rose to join it.

events.summary: Ajani recognizes the giant dragon as Sarkhan in his transformed dragon form.
events.quote: It was Sarkhan in his dragon form.

events.summary: Khan Felothar receives Narset and Elspeth before the Council of Houses and insists on lengthy hospitality, delaying their mission.
events.quote: We have all the time in the world.

events.summary: House heads squabble about trade and the waymaster's intrusion while Narset explains they are seeking a temple promised by a voice at the Crucible.
events.quote: we were told by a voice in the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon that there was a temple we needed to find in the dragonstorms.

events.summary: Ajani bursts into the chamber to report that Sarkhan has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.
events.quote: Sarkhan Vol has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.

events.summary: Elspeth and Ajani are reunited and speak of Melira's sacrifice and the past he cannot leave.
Felothar asks to hear more and Ajani begins to tell his tale.

relations.quote: Sarkhan had seen in Taigam a grief cousin to his own.
Like when he was under Nicol Bolas's thumb.
colleague and I are on a mission to determine whether it is possible to ameliorate the problem
Felothar was a soldier before she was a khan
The Abzan and the Jeskai have always been at odds.
Leave the past with the dead, Ajani,
